title: Easetech
description: Development of a modern platform that facilitates document and wayleave workflows between organizations and clients. The system includes user registration, quote requests, document handling, and geospatial data interactions.
detailedDescription:
This platform streamlines the complex process of managing documents and wayleave agreements between service providers and their clients. The system includes user registration of different types, quote requests, document handling, and geospatial data interactions. The system ensures seamless communication, transparent workflows, and secure handling of sensitive information, helping organizations reduce manual work and accelerate approval cycles. Built with scalability and user experience in mind, it supports both internal teams and external users in a unified environment.

Key Responsibilities & Achievements:

Front-End Development
Developed multiple website pages, including marketing landing pages and functional views, based on initial wireframes and Figma designs.

Implemented responsive layouts for all screen sizes, including ultra-small screens (≥280px width).

Built and integrated user registration/login flows:
- Registration, login, forgot/reset password, email confirmation
- Routing setup with React Router, including NotFound pages for invalid users/companies

Designed and implemented complex form flows, including:
- Custom field rendering by type (text, date, file, GeoJSON, etc.)
- Dynamic validation and conditional logic
- Integration with HubSpot for form submissions and CRM pipelines
- Merged form logic with both the backend (Strapi) and HubSpot workflows to display, store, and process client data (confirmation emails, quote requests, contact info)

Map & Geospatial Features
Integrated Mapbox map components with modal windows, drawing tools, and upload functionality (e.g., .kml file support)

Implemented geometric calculations using Turf.js:
- Recursive parsing of FeatureCollection, GeometryCollection, Polygon, LineString, Point
- Automatic extraction of geo-features (area, length, number of points)
- Conditional rendering and error handling for invalid uploads or drawings

CMS & Backend (Strapi)
Defined and structured dynamic content types in Strapi, including:
- Forms, company data, user metadata, quote request storage

Connected front-end forms to the Strapi backend via REST API

Took first steps in backend development, including content type creation and testing of dynamic endpoints

tickedBoxes.tickedDescription: Built dynamic forms with conditional fields, validation logic, and integration with HubSpot and Strapi
Implemented interactive maps with drawing tools, Turf.js-based geometry calculations, and .kml file support
Created content types and structured backend data storage for quotes, companies, and users
Developed responsive layouts for all screen sizes, including ultra-small displays (≥280px)

title: Geometrical Calculator
description: A React-based calculator for computing basic geometric properties based on sides or coordinate points.
detailedDescription:
Geometry Calculator is a web tool designed to compute key properties of basic shapes including area and perimeter, using both direct numeric values and coordinate-based input. For now the app supports squares, rectangles, and circles aligned with the coordinate axes (axis-aligned geometry).

Built with React, TypeScript, and Ant Design, the tool prioritizes accuracy, clarity, and performance. Users can input shape dimensions manually or by providing coordinates, and receive instant calculations along with timestamps for each action.

The system also includes coordinate validation logic, which detects incorrect or illogical input such as coordinates that do not match the selected shape or violate its expected position within the coordinate plane, and provides users with meaningful error feedback.

tickedBoxes.tickedDescription: Developed dynamic Ant Design forms supporting both numeric input and coordinate-based data entry.
Implemented logic to compute area and perimeter of axis-aligned squares, rectangles, and circles.
Built validation to detect incorrect coordinates that don’t match expected shape rules or alignment.
Each calculation includes a visible timestamp to track user actions during a session.
